notes: the two branches meet at «جميعا عن سفيان» («جميعا» converges them), so Sufyan and «بهذا الإسناد» are the shared tail
«أبي» is a bare relation (father of محمد بن نمير), the first branch's second name
«وزاد في حديث عبد الرزاق» is a remark about the same narrator's wording: not a variant group, left out
